items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar + AvatarGroup
items.description: Avatar with auto-initials fallback, optional status dot (online/away/busy/offline), and size tokens. Plus AvatarGroup for stacked overlap with overflow `+N`. Wraps the shadcn primitive — no fallback boilerplate at call sites.

items.name: page-header
items.title: PageHeader
items.description: Standard top-of-page header with title, optional description, eyebrow, breadcrumbs slot, and right-aligned actions slot. Responsive (actions stack below title on mobile).

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Breadcrumbs auto-generated from the current pathname (or pass `items` to override). Supports labelOverrides for dynamic segments and a custom separator.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell + useAppShell
items.description: Sidebar + topbar + content shell with persisted collapse state, mobile drawer with backdrop, and a useAppShell hook for descendants to read the current state. Pairs with `sidebar`.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar (config-driven)
items.description: Config-driven sidebar — pass an `items` array of links or nested groups. Active state from pathname, role-based filtering, optional badges, collapse toggle pulling state from AppShell.

items.name: tab-nav
items.title: TabNav (URL-synced)
items.description: Tab navigation with two modes: `path` (real Link navigation, active matched by pathname) and `query` (?tab= search param, single page). Supports badges, hidden + disabled tabs, controlled-mode onChange.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: ThemeToggle
items.description: next-themes-backed theme toggle. Dropdown variant (Light/Dark/System) or cycle variant (light↔dark). Mount-gated to dodge SSR mismatch. Requires <ThemeProvider attribute='class'> in the root layout.
